# NorthWeb Co.
> Professional website design for local businesses across Northeast India.

NorthWeb Co. is a freelance web design service operated by Ankur, based in Northeast India.
We build fast, mobile-first websites for clothing stores, restaurants, and cafes.

## Pages
- /index.html — Home page: services, pricing, demo, process, FAQ
- /pages/booking.html — Book a free consultation
- /pages/policies.html — Privacy policy, terms, refund policy, cookie policy

## Services
- Collection Showcase website for clothing stores (₹8,000–12,000)
- D2C E-commerce website for clothing brands (₹25,000–45,000)
- Restaurant & cafe website (₹10,000–18,000)
- Local SEO add-on (from ₹4,000/month)
